interpretation.hungerDirection: Higher saved needs.hunger means fuller; low category <30, not a clinical diagnosis.
interpretation.routeDistance: Remaining original decoded routePool polyline length at endpoint; no rerouting, network shortest-path, floor permission or future movement success inferred.
interpretation.nearestShop: Original straight 3D distance to existing stocked open affordable food shop door; not a legal route, service point arrival, or production chooser travel cost.
interpretation.ownerFunds: Actual saved company.capital replaces bound shop.cash; open/inventory/price/owner/employees are fields, not replayed operational predicates.
interpretation.causeBoundary: Observed tasks/positions and original meal events establish current travel/arrival evidence. Code guards describe required conditions but unobserved function-point/route/quote decisions remain unproven.
interpretation.employment: Role/workId/target owner are observed identities only; no isEmployed reconstruction or claim every role is currently paid/employed.
